ThingDef.label: devil bug
ThingDef.description: An insect mamono born of the megascarab, and built like a cockroach - flat, hard-shelled and quick to scuttle into any gap. She stands at the bottom of the hive's order: she raises and patches the walls her sisters live in, hauls what they leave behind, and is treated as a pest by the very women she shelters.

HediffDef.label: devil bug
HediffDef.description: A devil bug mamono of the swarm.

ThingDef.label: giant ant
ThingDef.description: An insect mamono born of the spelopede. Diligent and honest to the core, she digs and hauls and fights from dawn until her pheromone-heavy sweat drives the colony's men to distraction.

HediffDef.label: giant ant
HediffDef.description: A giant ant mamono of the swarm.

ThingDef.label: soldier beetle
ThingDef.description: An insect mamono born of the megaspider. Her exoskeleton is armour from birth, and the weapon she grows out of it is her own; quiet, obedient and expressionless, she escorts the man she claims as her own like heavy cavalry.

HediffDef.label: soldier beetle
HediffDef.description: A soldier beetle mamono of the swarm.

ThingDef.label: greenworm
ThingDef.description: An insect mamono born of the larva. Soft, gentle and slow, she tends the hive's tunnels and eats far more than her sisters - and one day she spins a cocoon and comes out a papillon.

HediffDef.label: greenworm
HediffDef.description: A greenworm mamono of the swarm.

ThingDef.label: vamp mosquito
ThingDef.description: An insect mamono born of the locust. She circles her prey on buzzing wings, patient and cunning, until the moment is right - then her bite leaves a hot, itching mark that only she can soothe.

HediffDef.label: vamp mosquito
HediffDef.description: A vamp mosquito mamono of the swarm.

ThingDef.label: abaddon
ThingDef.description: An insect mamono born of the hive queen. Daughter of the bug mamono lord who once nearly devoured the world, she never sleeps, never hungers for rest, and endlessly brings forth daughters - her pheromones command the swarm and stir every man who smells them.

li.label: Hive queen
li.text: You've discovered the center of the nest. It's guarded by a massive insect queen!

HediffDef.label: abaddon
HediffDef.description: An abaddon mamono of the swarm.

ThingDef.label: abaddon folk
ThingDef.description: An insect mamono of the swarm's soldier class, called a soldier bug. Small, quick and nearly without a will of her own, she reads her orders out of the air and carries them out without a word - until she has a man of her own, and then she answers to nothing but him.

HediffDef.label: abaddon folk
HediffDef.description: An abaddon folk mamono of the swarm.

ThingDef.label: arachne
ThingDef.description: An insect mamono born of the great weavers: a woman's body on a spider's, with eight legs, a silk sac and a cruel patience. She knows exactly how long a caught man can struggle before the struggle is the point.

HediffDef.label: arachne
HediffDef.description: An arachne mamono of the swarm: eight legs, a weaver's hands and a silk sac.

ThingDef.label: beelzebub
ThingDef.description: A fly mamono of the swarm, called the lord of gluttony by anyone who has fed her. Small enough to sit in a man's lap and quick enough to leave it before his arms close, she eats whatever she finds and covets whatever she finds next.

HediffDef.label: beelzebub
HediffDef.description: A beelzebub mamono of the swarm.

ThingDef.label: girtablilu
ThingDef.description: A woman's body on a scorpion's: plated chitin, pincer hands, and venom in every blow. Her name means the assassin of the desert, and she hunts the same way in the swarm - she charges, she stings, and she is always hungry for the kill.

HediffDef.label: girtablilu
HediffDef.description: A girtablilu mamono of the swarm: a scorpion's plated lower body on a woman's.

ThingDef.label: ant arachne
ThingDef.description: A smaller arachne wearing an ant's colours: a woman's body on a spider's, with a builder's hands, a silk sac, and no patience for anything but work.

HediffDef.label: ant arachne
HediffDef.description: A smaller arachne mamono of the hive, wearing a giant ant's colours.

ThingDef.label: honey bee
ThingDef.description: An insect mamono of the hive's fields: a round, soft-bodied woman whose every waking hour is spent on the crops and the animals. She hums while she works, and the honey she makes collects in her body until someone comes to take it.

HediffDef.label: honey bee
HediffDef.description: A honey bee mamono of the hive.

ThingDef.label: mothman
ThingDef.description: An insect mamono of the hive's quiet corners: a soft, dusty-winged woman who keeps to the dark until a lamp is lit, and then cannot leave it alone. She is gentle to the point of uselessness in a fight, and happier than anyone else in the village.

HediffDef.label: mothman
HediffDef.description: A mothman mamono of the insector hive.

ThingDef.label: papillon
ThingDef.description: An insect mamono of the hive's flower rows: a bright-winged, soft-bodied woman who could not hurt anyone if she tried, and who is very good company. She thinks faster than her sisters, feels everything more sharply, and knows it.

HediffDef.label: papillon
HediffDef.description: A papillon mamono of the insector hive.

ThingDef.label: hornet
ThingDef.description: An insect mamono of the hive's ranks: a long-legged wasp woman, banded in yellow and black, quick to anger and quicker to sting. She is the hive's first fighter and its only flier, and the smell of honey is enough to set her off.

HediffDef.label: hornet
HediffDef.description: A hornet mamono of the insector hive.

ThingDef.label: mantis
ThingDef.description: A mantis mamono of the insector swarm: a woman's frame with a mantis's folded blades, built to kill in one pass and never to trade blows.

HediffDef.label: mantis
HediffDef.description: A mantis mamono of the insector swarm.
